relationships.subject: photobiomodulation
relationships.evidence_quote: Evaluation with IHC displayed a significant rise in VEGF expression after 3 days in the PBMT group compared to the control (p > 0.05).

relationships.subject: photobiomodulation
relationships.evidence_quote: The level of IL-1 expression decreased significantly in the PBMT group compared to the control after 7 days (p < 0.05)

key_findings: PBMT increased VEGF and PTGIR and decreased IL-1 in rat calvarial defects.
